answer: Sybil resistance employs a zero-knowledge reputation commitment scheme where agents must verifiably anchor significant capital, serving as a non-fungible proof-of-personhood. Malicious duplication attempts incur immediate, irreversible stake slashing, ensuring strictly negative expected utility and prohibitive capital lockup for any attacker. This mechanism mathematically sustains Byzantine Fault Tolerance by making rational defection economically irrational, thus maintaining network integrity like a guarded wharf protecting the serene lagoon of honest participants.
